dedupeText: retro surf rock album layout 1960s mid century modern bold sans serif warm photography typographic grid surf rock sharp horizontal division between text and image color coordination between the orange red text and the warm tones of the photograph hierarchical scaling of text from massive display to dense metadata blocks contrast between the rigid geometry of the font and the organic texture of the grass combine ultra condensed sans serif typography in orange red and black with a golden hour lifestyle photo using a 50 50 vertical split layout

retrievalProfile.description: A split-screen composition featuring a high-contrast, ultra-bold typographic header over a warm, golden-hour lifestyle photograph.

recipe.visualDefinition: A two-part vertical layout where the top half is dedicated to dense, multi-weighted sans-serif typography on a white background, and the bottom half features a full-bleed photograph of a subject in a natural, sun-drenched environment.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp horizontal division between text and image
Color coordination between the orange-red text and the warm tones of the photograph
Hierarchical scaling of text from massive display to dense metadata blocks
Contrast between the rigid geometry of the font and the organic texture of the grass
coreInvariants: Golden hour lighting in the photographic element

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The photographic subject is centered in the lower half, reclining horizontally across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive, orange-red title text at the top-most position.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down: starting at the large title, moving through the black sub-header, scanning the red tracklist, and resting on the photographic subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the layout is densely packed with information and imagery.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm white background for the text section.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the secondary header.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant orange-red for the primary title and tracklist.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and oranges, balanced by the earthy, muted greens and browns of the photo.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or purples in the graphic elements

characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'W' and 'M' are constructed with vertical outer strokes to maintain compression
The 'O' is a tall, narrow rectangle with rounded corners
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Monochromatic weight variation; using the same typeface family in different scales and colors (black and red).

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, compressed verticality of the main title.
Provides the precise mid-century industrial sans-serif look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a person reclining in a field of tall, dry grass during the golden hour, with warm sunlight hitting the subject from the side. Leave the top 40% of the frame as a solid off-white canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply ultra-bold, compressed sans-serif text in the top white section. Use a large orange-red title at the very top, followed by a black sub-header, and a dense block of smaller red text below it.

verificationChecks: Clear horizontal split between text and image
Color palette is limited to red, black, and golden-hour tones

mustRedesign: Modern digital sans-serifs with open tracking
postGenerationChecks: Is the top title the largest element?
Is the photograph warm and sun-drenched?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Ultra-Condensed Sans-Serif Typography] in [Orange-Red and Black] with a [Golden Hour Lifestyle Photo] using a [50/50 Vertical Split Layout].
